🎥🎬: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023)

Miles Morales is reunited with Gwen Stacy and discovers a whole multiverse filled with different versions of Spider-Man. When he meets the Spider-Society, he learns that being a Spider-Man comes with events that are supposedly destined to happen.

But Miles refuses to accept that his future has already been decided. Determined to protect the people he loves, he goes against the Spider-Society and finds himself on a journey across multiple dimensions.

As Miles fights to change his own story, the film ends on a massive cliffhanger, leaving his fate—and the future of the Spider-Verse—hanging in the balance.
